remarks: Welcome to 19 Emerson St in Norwalk, CT, a beautiful 3-bedroom, 1-bath, 1-level apartment. Step inside and immediately feel at home in the bright and airy living room, complete with a slider to a private deck, perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The adjacent dining space provides you with the perfect place to entertain friends and family, and the kitchen offers crisp white cabinets for a contemporary, updated feel. Both bedrooms are just steps away from the living room and offer decent storage. And there is an additional room which could be used as a 3rd bedroom or office. Freshly painted and boasting newer laminate flooring throughout, this home is move-in ready. This apartment is set in an ideal location, in close proximity to nearby restaurants, shopping, and easy access to highways and MetroNorth. Don't miss your chance to own this incredible two bedroom apartment at 19 Emerson St Unit 2. Schedule your tour today!
